📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #56 in the last 7 days (ki-24 group-fires). 2 groups this cycle (this DM covers both — Group B suppressed as same-cycle duplicate).
Playbook: 1) Confirm via DD metric `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{...resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}` — multiple >3s points cluster = the pattern. 2) Confirm latency-only: `service:runtime-core-api status:error` should be 0. 3) Diagnostic gap = identify the slow span: DD APM traces `service:runtime-core-api @duration:>5s` in the spike window, tag-break by `@account_name`/tenant DB. 4) Mitigation pending root cause: raise threshold to 4s (masks) / per-resource circuit breaker / targeted SQL+Mongo index fixes (root cause).
Open Jira: n/a — none filed (fix_status: investigating, 150 occurrences)

Source alerts (2 groups, 3 alerts total):
  • Group A (runtime-monitoring, 12:49:06 UTC): https://method.slack.com/archives/C063V5HTTFU/p1781527746242049
  • Group B (alert-system, 13:02:27 UTC): https://method.slack.com/archives/CPHHABKAA/p1781528547778619
  • Group B sat (alert-system, 13:06:28 UTC): https://method.slack.com/archives/CPHHABKAA/p1781528788459589

Evidence (latency-only confirmed — 0 errors, 0 5XX, 0 Redis cmd errors):
  • DD monitor (RTC Screen Load p95): https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700 — last_triggered 13:06:20Z (aligns Group B sat @13:06:28Z)
  • DD logs (runtime-core errors, empty): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20status%3Aerror%20env%3Aprod&from_ts=1781527320000&to_ts=1781529000000&live=false
  • DD metric (Screen Load p95): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Aruntime-core-api%2Cresource_name%3Apost_%2Fapi%2Fv1%2Fruntime%2Fload%2F_screenid*&exp_agg=p95&start=1781527200&end=1781529000&live=false
  • Kibana: ES queries failed (HTTP 401)
  • This-window peaks: Group A MAX 30.8s Screen Load @12:47:50Z / 19.84s Action Exec @12:49:40Z (p95 stayed <3s); Group B p95 7.74s Screen Load @13:06:00Z + 6.63s Action Exec @13:06:20Z (dual-endpoint). No deploy (runtime-core last 2026-05-06, 40d).

📚 *KB update — pir-ingest 2026-06-15*

*1 new entry* added to `kb/known-issues.json` from the Method PIR Confluence blog (pageId 133496969), confidence **0.95**. Deduped against all 62 existing entries by title-overlap + `fix_jira`; every other PIR incident block was already represented (or skipped as a pre-template 2023 block lacking a "Prepared by" field).

• `ki-stockapp-shuttle-widget-cancel-invalid-receivepayment` — _Invalid ReceivePayment accounting logs created when a customer cancels from within the Shuttle payment widget_ — JIRA **PL-54549**
   Stock-app execution change (May 2025, Greg Hitchon) didn't handle widget-initiated cancellations → ~38 accounts / 86 erroneous payment logs; no monitoring caught it (customer-reported). `fix_status=resolved`.

Committed locally to `main` as `9a1c88f`. _Not pushed — push to origin/main needs your approval._

🛠️ *KB update — added `ki-2026-06-15-runtime-core-updateviews-linkedviatablename-nre` to kb/known-issues.json*
_Informational — no action needed. The runtime team owns this and has a PR in flight._

*What:* The recurring server-side NullReferenceException in #alert-runtime-monitoring (DD error-tracking monitor 227951254, first seen johnsandy/WO) now has a confirmed-enough root cause, so I seeded a known-issue entry. Future firings will auto-match and suppress instead of re-investigating hourly.

*Root cause (operator-accepted this cycle):* a field with `IsLinked=true` but a null `LinkedViaTableName` reaches the non-null-safe `NormalizeViewName()` via `RetrieveLinkedFieldsAsync`. Both Claude and Codex independently converged on this. Fix lives in **runtime-core `UpdateViewsCommand.cs`** (null-guard) — corrected from last cycle's ms-tables-fields-api guess. Still unverified by reproduction; bad-data origin TBD.

*Status:* fix_status=in-progress · fix_jira=PL-59777 · confidence 0.85. Mohammad created the PR + updated the ticket at 17:09Z.

*This cycle's 2 runtime alerts* (16:13 + 16:44 UTC, group `53a3a8ca`): escalation DM suppressed (score 1 < 4; operators actively engaged). Investigation: docs/investigations/2026-06-15-53a3a8caedcab3da.md

*Caveat:* ES/Logstash still 401 (~15th day) — I could not pull the stack trace independently; attribution rests on the operator thread + DD error-tracking issue.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-06-15-runtime-core-updateviews-linkedviatablename-nre`
This is occurrence #3 in the last 7 days (1st seen ~16:05Z today). Surfacing because the fix is **not deployed** and operators have gone quiet — see below.

*Playbook:* Confirm signature is the view/field-metadata NRE (NormalizeViewName / RetrieveLinkedFieldsAsync / null LinkedViaTableName), not the GetAccountBySubdomain NRE (ki-29). Check PL-59777 / whether the runtime-core UpdateViewsCommand.cs null-guard PR merged + deployed. If recurring post-deploy, the guard missed a path → reopen with fresh logstash stack.
*Open Jira:* https://method.atlassian.net/browse/PL-59777 (status **To Do**, unassigned, last touched 17:03Z) · NCNG-630 (bad view metadata) Ready For Development

*Status note:* PR referenced last cycle is **not** confirmed merged (runtime-core not clonable, GitHub 403); PL-59777 still To Do. No operator activity in #alert-runtime-monitoring for >1h. So the operator-engaged suppression from the last two cycles no longer holds — it's still firing in prod with no deployed fix.

*Source alerts (1 total):*
  • https://method.slack.com/archives/C063V5HTTFU/p1781550332845809  (alert-runtime-monitoring, 19:05 UTC)

*Evidence:*
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/227951254 — error-tracking "New issue to review" (Alert)
  • DD logs: 0 hits for `"object reference not set"` / `NormalizeViewName` in window — NRE surfaces via APM error-tracking only, not the logs index
  • Kibana: ES queries failed (HTTP 401, ~15th day)
  • This-window concentration: n/a — ES 401; affected account not resolvable this cycle (first-seen account was johnsandy/WO)

*Suggested next action:* nudge PL-59777 owner — confirm the UpdateViewsCommand null-guard PR is merged/deployed; if already deployed, the guard missed a path and needs the fresh stack (blocked until ES recovers).
